title: Research: Clifford reciprocal-basis obstruction and opposite-direction exception
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

One higher-rank tensor Clifford child cannot replace equal-width, same-direction independent lanes through an arbitrary invertible reciprocal basis change, even with arbitrary dirty padding restored. This package proves the all-size characteristic-zero statement using square trace, dimension and `tr(A) tr(A^3)`, extending the basis choice beyond the prior monomial support argument while keeping independent nonreciprocal adapters outside its scope.

The direction premise is essential. Two opposite-direction width-f lanes are similar to a phased width-(f+1) child iff f is odd; f divisible by four permits only an unchanged-rank child, and f congruent to two permits none. Three complete rational basis witnesses are supplied. For sixteen uniform rank-one lanes on 32 coordinates, every reciprocal encoding plus a left correction needs `rank(F-I)>=6`; this is a structural lower bound, not a recursive-cost lower bound or attainment claim.

Even with the odd-width encodings free, the inherited volume-linear budget gives `2 A V (f+1)^sigma > 2 A V f^sigma`. This compares available upper-bound expressions, not optimal runtime. No physical decoder, 5% construction-gate success, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed. Only `research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction/` is added.

## Task and overlap

Base current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; chooser nonce `5539eb9e61a07a24d746ce2018c34aba`, revision-3 `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope `02b31ebd160542c86299/reciprocal-linear-encoding/uniform-and-opposite-directions`. [Discussion1901](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1901) records the claim and completion. TASK.json explicitly records the changed scope from physical synthesis to the prerequisite contract theorem and its exact direction exception.

PR679 supplies the monomial support/volume argument. Ross Richardson's completed source-bound audit at `8a3900c84213fd7603b99beaceaff48f501b4232` is read and credited, not replayed. PR1779 head `1e3128bf642bbaf250b7d6b9639b2bb24b98ce5e` proposes diagonal batches; PR1817 head `ac3a759e874e8e526bc884fc2cb8eb114695b063` verifies retimed original children and leaves their replacement open. This result does not repeat their support counts, scheduling or hosting audits. Exact live kernel and PR679 source blobs/hashes are in SOURCES.json; selected/catalogue pins are historical provenance. Final 13:45–13:46 UTC snapshots covered 567 open PRs including drafts and 539 Discussion records with complete pagination. ToikY's parallel [clean-subspace claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1901#discussioncomment-18925296) explicitly leaves this full-space result to this work; its clean injective premise is outside our theorem. PR1651's opposite-direction root shears concern another operator. TASK.json records coverage limits; no novelty guarantee is claimed. Main and both named PR heads were rechecked unchanged.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction
```

Passed on CPython 3.12.10, Windows 11, standard library only: 28,032 dimension-matched spectral fixtures through f=64, all four phases and both child directions; independent cyclic multiplicities; 2,728 native Gaussian matrix entries checked against separately executed butterflies; three complete rational basis identities; independent Gaussian elimination and four nonmonomial correction-rank probes. Six focused tests cover exact eigenspaces, phase/basis mutations, domain and duplicate-key rejection, actual source/inventory and receipt/type corruption, optimized read-only no-Git export and deterministic regeneration. Registered optimized replay, source/metadata pins, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass. VALIDATION.json records exact receipt hashes.

The all-size proof is written mathematics, not kernel verification or independent human review. Full selected cold replay, new physical/compiler/hosting and precision/tape contracts, Lean and hosted CI were not run locally.

Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, code, checks and writing. No subagents. Apache-2.0; existing sources/notices remain intact.

## Open next questions

The README/TASK give two bounded continuations: an independently priced nonreciprocal adapter, or a real opposite-direction boundary with a proved changed volume contract. Arbitrary independent maps can force an invertible target, but legal inexpensive adapters remain missing. The inherited joined-array tariff already rejects the displayed mixed identity with conversions free.
